common.tagline: Tables, kitchen and bills for your restaurant, on any tablet or phone.
common.featureTables: Tables and orders at a glance
common.featureBills: Bills paid in cash, bKash or Nagad

assistant.title: Chalai assistant
assistant.subtitle: This restaurant, right now
assistant.greeting: Hi! Ask me about **{name}**: tables, orders to approve, the kitchen and today's sales.
assistant.note: Answers use the live floor, orders and menu.
assistant.demoNote: Demo restaurant. Answers use the sample service on this device.
assistant.unavailable: I couldn't load that just now. Check the connection and ask again.
assistant.floor: **{busy} of {tables} tables** are in use. {free} are free.
assistant.floorSeats: {taken} of {seats} seats are taken. Open bills come to **{bills}**.
assistant.floorQueues: {approval} waiting for approval, {ready} with food ready, {bills} asked for the bill.
assistant.floorEmpty: Every table is free. {tables} tables, {seats} seats.
assistant.approvalOne: **Table {table}** has an order waiting for approval ({total}).
assistant.readyNone: Nothing is waiting to be served.
assistant.billsNone: No table has asked for the bill.
assistant.kitchen: Kitchen: **{queued} new**, {preparing} cooking, {ready} ready to serve.
assistant.kitchenDenied: I can't see the kitchen queue from this account.
assistant.sales: Today you've taken **{total}** from {orders} paid orders.
assistant.salesOpen: {open} orders are still open, **{due}** still to collect.
assistant.menuDenied: Your account can't open the menu. A manager can.
assistant.help: Ask about tables, orders to approve, food that's ready, bills, the kitchen or today's sales.
assistant.greet: Hi! What do you want to know about **{name}**?
assistant.fallback: I can tell you about tables, incoming orders, the kitchen, bills and today's sales. Try one of those.

login.title: Staff log in
login.body: Waiters, cashiers, managers, kitchen and owners log in here.
login.help: Forgot your password? Ask the owner to reset it.

password.title: Choose your own password
password.body: Welcome, {name}. Your password was temporary: pick one only you know.

noPlan.title: Your plan doesn't include the POS
noPlan.body: The cashier, waiter and kitchen screens come with the Service and Complete plans. Ask the owner to upgrade from the Chalai owner app, or contact Chalai support.
noPlan.suspendedBody: The account is on hold. The owner can contact Chalai support to turn it back on.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The page couldn't load. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.notFoundBody: That order or page doesn't exist any more.
error.offlineBody: No internet right now. Keep taking orders in the offline till; they upload when the connection is back.

floor.title: Floor
floor.paidTable: Order #{number} is paid. Table {table} is free now.

stats.bookedHint: {n, plural, one {# booking} other {# bookings}} today

floor.noTables: No tables yet. The owner adds tables in the Chalai owner app.

floor.sceneHint: Drag to turn the room. Tap a table to open it.
floor.noneBusy: No table is busy. Open one from the Tables tab.

session.closedDetail: Start your session at the beginning of the day. End it before you log out.
session.endBody: Do this when your day is over. Count the cash in the drawer first, then you'll see your shift report.
session.logoutBody: Your session is still open. End it before you log out.
session.countHint: Count the cash and type the total. Leave it empty to skip.
session.countInvalid: Type the amount in taka, like 1250.
session.startFailed: Couldn't start the session. Check the connection and try again.
session.endFailed: Couldn't end the session. Check the connection and try again.
session.alreadyEnded: This session was already ended on another device.
session.paymentsCount: {n, plural, =0 {No payments} one {1 payment} other {# payments}} · {orders, plural, =0 {no orders closed} one {1 order closed} other {# orders closed}}
session.cashExpected: Cash that should be in the drawer
session.cancelledTitle: Cancelled at the branch during the shift
session.openingInvalid: Type the amount in taka, like 500.
session.moveTitle: Cash in or out of the drawer
session.moveBody: Record cash you put in or take out, like change from the bank or money for ice. It changes the cash the drawer should have.
session.moveInvalid: Enter a whole taka amount above 0 and a reason.
session.moveFailed: Couldn't save. Check the connection and try again.
session.dayClosed: The owner already closed this business day.
session.soFarNote: Your shift is still open. This is not the final report.
session.reportFailed: Couldn't load the report. Try again.
session.lockBody: The register stays locked until you do. Opening cash is optional.
session.staleTitle: An earlier session is still open
session.staleBody: End it first (count the drawer), then start today's session.

demo.title: Chalai POS demo
demo.body: A sample restaurant that lives only in this browser. Nothing is sent anywhere, so try anything. Open the kitchen screen in a second tab to watch orders move.
demo.guestOrderHint: As if a guest scanned a table's QR code and ordered from their phone.

kot.heading: KITCHEN ORDER
kot.fallback: Printed because the kitchen screen was offline

offline.title: Offline till
offline.lead: No internet. What you do here is saved on this tablet and sent to Chalai, in order, when the connection is back.

offline.send: Send to kitchen and print slip
offline.paidInFull: Paid in full. It will be uploaded with the rest.
offline.badAmount: Enter an amount up to what is due.

problem.item_unavailable: A dish ran out while you were offline. Discard this order and take it again without that dish.
problem.idempotency_conflict: This was already sent with different details.
problem.order_closed: The order was already closed on another device.
problem.drawer_off: The owner turned the cash drawer off, so this press wasn't logged.

drawer.title: Cash drawer
drawer.notConnected: Connect the receipt printer the drawer is plugged into. You do this once on this tablet.

drawer.connectHelp: Chrome shows a list of devices: pick the receipt printer. On Windows, if the USB option fails, try the serial port.
drawer.connected: Printer connected. The drawer should have opened.
drawer.usbFailed: Couldn't use that printer over USB. On Windows, try Connect as serial port.
drawer.failed: The drawer didn't open. Check the printer is on and its USB cable is in.
drawer.logged: Your name, the time and the reason are saved for the owner.
